question.order_text: I'd like a pizza to help lower my risk of heart disease, type 2 diabetes, obesity, and some forms of cancer... with basil.
I want a tomato sauce pizza with meat and eggplant but I don't like them touching each other.
One Meat Lovers and two Green Dreams!
Feels like an all meat pizza kind of day. Not the fancy meats though.
Double order of Puttanesca on tomato sauce.
I want a pizza that dances! Let's do a half-spicy tango and half-fruity ballet! Eight slices.
Basil and apples. Make that two to go.
I'm so hungry I can't even think. Just throw everything you have on a pie.
Gimme three apple, onion, and pepperoni pizzas! 24 slices total!
Everybody wants this. Everybody wants to be like me, eating a peach pizza with chicken.
What's the best food to eat while watching the game? Chips and dip! Or better yet, cheese on a crispy flatbread!
Three pizzas with pesto. Make one chicken, one olive, and one mushroom.
I'll take a salty-sweet pineapple and olive pie, please.
So, I heard that people are shipping pesto and seafood together. I'm TOTALLY onboard for that!
One spicy Meat Lovers and two veggie pizzas!
A voice spoke to me in a dream last night, saying: "Apples stay afloat on the sea". What could it mean?
Flatbread with fungi. Make it crispy.
I want a Coastal Classic and a not-so-classic meat! Just give me all of them on that second pie, thanks.
I need a pizza that represents my mood today: peppy and corny.
Pesto is the best! Avocado makes me feel like I won the lotto. I was born to eat corn. And if I'm not mistaken, all these ingredients taste great with bacon.
I want one pizza with seafood, one fruity pig, and one Stinky Pete. But could you add avocado to each one and cut them into 8 slices?
One fruity pizza for me, please!
I'll take 3 Meat Lovers pizzas. Make one with pesto sauce.
I'd like an apple pizza, please! Both the pine- and non-pine varieties, preferably.
I love meat, but my friend is pescatarian. Can you come to a compromise for us?
One Coastal Classic and one of those no-sauce scallop and truffle ones, please.
I want a fruity autumn topping I can share with my cat!
If you really like me, you'll make me two Coastal Classics.
One side meat on wheat, one side jalapeño flatbread. I'm helping a friend sweat out a fever!
Winner winner, chicken dinner!
Enough talk. More pizza! Darken two cheese pizzas in the oven.
I want a Classic Meat, I want a Meat Lovers, and I want a...Green Dream!
Normally, I wouldn't think to put pesto on a cheese pizza. But that guy in the green shirt was very convincing!
Spice up a Classic Meat! Dark crust.
Let's do a half vegetarian and half anchovy flatbread on wheat, okay?
I am SO hungry. Can I have two chicken pizzas with onion?
Everything here looks so delicious, but my stomach is weak to any meat or cheese...

My siblings and I want to settle a bet. I think pumpkin is the best with olives and onions, my sister likes it with sausage, and the other just likes it by itself. Make the pizzas, and we'll see who's right.
On my pizza, I want chicken. But also, what chickens eat!
Lots of olives! Olives and sausage! Three pizzas!
Three pizzas with pesto. One of them should have basil and figs, two of them should be Fruity Pigs.
Three P pizza, please.
When was the last time you just sat and enjoyed a pizza? I want to have that moment with an Apple Crisp.
My mother makes amazing zucchini wheat bread. I wonder how yours pairs with shrimp, cheese, and a basil dip?
Gotta get myself a pizza with pepperoni.
Can I get half chicken parm, half creamy pesto shrimp?
A Fruity Pig and a Vegetarian pizza sound downright heavenly right now.
HAM! I WANT HAM!
Gimme a half Salty Sailor and half Stinky Pete.
Gimme one Green Dream, one Stinky Pete, and one onion zucchini jalapeno pie. Pesto on all three!
Peach fuzz is meant to protect the fruit from insects! I just use garlic to repel insects. One peach and garlic pie, please!
Meat on red, artichokes on anything, cheese on everything, in one pizza.
A duck walked up to a pizza stand, and he said to the man running the stand, "Hey! Got any Vegetarians?" Make me that vegetarian pizza— and a duck pizza to keep it company!
Have you ever seen the movie Za Wars? I heard the color of Luke Piewalker's bite-saber was inspired by a soft green fruit, a crunchy green fruit, and green sauce!
Sliced tomatoes on pesto sounds delicious! But then again, having them with tomato sauce makes sense...
A Capricciosa and a Vegetarian. The Capricciosa's got the ham I actually want — the Vegetarian's just so I can pretend I'm being healthy.
I'm feeling like a princess today. Could you bake me a peach pizza?
I need one pizza with pepperoni, mushrooms, olives, and sausage, and another just cheese.
Can I have a flatbread with pesto sauce on one side only? Put sliced tomatoes and chicken on it, too. But don't let the sliced tomatoes touch the pesto sauce!
A pork pizza is the bane of my existence and the object of my desires.
Double order of pumpkin-corn pizzas. Use wheat dough for one of 'em!
I'd like half cheese bread and half sauce bread. Make that a double.
People say pineapple doesn't belong on pizza... But what if you added jalapenos?
Give me half a meat pie and then on the other side green greens to balance it out.
I'll have half vegetarian on pesto for health, half duck flatbread for fun. Put it on the wheat dough.
I'll take a Meat Lover's. And make sure you use red sauce!
I'm so hungry! Please combine Classic Meat and Capricciosa toppings on one pizza!
Part of me really wants a vegetarian pizza on wheat, and part of me really wants duck flatbread... AHH! Okay, okay, can you do... BOTH??
Bake me a pie with the juiciest red fruit! 8 slices.
I would like a vegan version of a Supreme pizza, please!
Mind making me a crispy pizza? Fruits on one side.
Herb and onion on wheat.
Please heat sweet wheat with meat for me to eat.
You miss 100% of the pizzas you don't order, so I'm ordering three pesto pizzas. Make each 50% ham and 50% Onion.
My favorite meal is fried chicken with corn and basil, plus sweet figs to balance the flavors.
Meat. Fruit. Different sides of the pizza. Got it?
I'd like two pizzas with pesto, mushrooms and sausage. And on one of those, can I get onions on one half?
I'm gonna need a pumpkin pizza. Add basil for a bit of extra flavor!
I wish I were a mermaid... A part of that world where they swim all day! For now, I'll settle for a fig pie with veggies.
I'll take two wheat pizzas with all your meats, please.
I had the most delicious roast duck with a balsamic fig glaze when I went to France! I only wished it didn't have balsamic in it...and that it was on a pizza...
RED! Gotta have it red! Pink is fine, but NO CHEESE! Cheese is not red!
I'd love it if my wheaty pizza was meaty on one side, plain apple on the other. Pesto and cheese on the meat side, nothing on the apple side.
Pizza is a funny thing. So delicious, yet fleeting. I want to savor one with pineapple.
I'm picky... I don't like sauce... or cheese... but I want pumpkin. Can you just put that on some dough, please?
My family loves meat, but my cholesterol's getting too high. Half meat pie on the red sauce for them, half cheese and zucchini for me.
Paradise always seems just out of reach...until now! Bake me a Paradise Pie!
Make a pizza with 180 degrees of white toppings!
I'm spending the day with my crush, hehe! Two Sunset Medley pizzas, please! Add green toppings to one of them.
Hey, is it weird to ask for corn on pizza? I'm just really curious about it.
Do you have wheat dough? Okay, I kind of want something new. Ehh, maybe an all-fruit pizza, but with some black diamonds?
I'm a vegetarian, but my friend is an ogre. He only eats meat. Half olive and onion, half nothing but ham, please!
Hey! Hey, listen. Shhh...listen, Ovenist. I...want...a...SPICY PEACH PIZZA!
I'm meatmaxxing. I'll take a meat pizza on tomato sauce.
I want a watermelon pizza, with no cheese!
Do you know what ratatouille is? I want that, but on a pizza!
I'd like a classic meat on classic wheat with a classic zucchini treat and peppers with that classic heat!
I want a pesto pizza with pepperoni and sausage. And I want another with olives and onions on one side, mushrooms on the other.
I can't decide if a supreme pizza would taste better with pesto or pizza sauce. Can I get one half/half?
